question: 10% s?n ph?m c? Revenue cao nh?t ??ng g?p bao nhi?u ph?n tr?m t?ng Revenue?
sql: WITH ranked_revenue AS (SELECT "Product_Name", SUM("Revenue") AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM("Revenue") DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM product_sales GROUP BY "Product_Name"), top_10_percent AS (SELECT SUM(total_revenue) AS top_revenue FROM ranked_revenue WHERE revenue_rank <= (SELECT COUNT(*) * 0.1 FROM ranked_revenue)) SELECT (top_revenue / (SELECT SUM("Revenue") FROM product_sales)) * 100 AS percent_of_total_revenue FROM top_10_percent
explanation: Tính tổng doanh thu cho từng sản phẩm, sau đó sắp xếp theo thứ tự giảm dần. Lấy 10% sản phẩm có doanh thu cao nhất và tính tổng doanh thu của chúng. Cuối cùng, tính tỷ lệ phần trăm của tổng doanh thu này so với tổng doanh thu của tất cả sản phẩm.

question: Trong m?i Region, t?m Category c? Profit Margin cao nh?t, sau ?? t?m Product_Name ??ng g?p nhi?u Revenue nh?t trong Category ??.
sql: WITH category_profit AS (SELECT "Region", "Category", AVG("Profit" / "Revenue") AS avg_profit_margin FROM product_sales GROUP BY "Region", "Category"), top_category AS (SELECT "Region", "Category", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "Region" ORDER BY avg_profit_margin DESC) AS row_num FROM category_profit), top_product AS (SELECT "Region", "Category", "Product_Name", SUM("Revenue") AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "Region", "Category" ORDER BY SUM("Revenue") DESC) AS row_num FROM product_sales GROUP BY "Region", "Category", "Product_Name") SELECT tc."Region", tc."Category", tp."Product_Name", tp.total_revenue FROM top_category tc JOIN top_product tp ON tc."Region" = tp."Region" AND tc."Category" = tp."Category" WHERE tc.row_num = 1 AND tp.row_num = 1
explanation: Tìm Category có Profit Margin cao nhất trong mỗi Region, sau đó tìm Product_Name có doanh thu cao nhất trong Category đó
